subject: Re: Encord | Abyss Wkly - Next steps
text:
Hi Niko,

Thank you for the detailed explanation and for sharing these valuable
insights. I'm happy to collaborate closely as we work towards the expected
behavior and gain more meaningful analytics to enhance our processes.

   -

   I reviewed the documentation around the “created labels” metric and
   understand that labels uploaded via the SDK are treated as newly created,
   as they are considered machine-generated rather than manually drawn. I do
   have a few ideas that we could potentially explore to work around this. For
   instance, since labels created via the SDK aren’t assigned to any
   annotator, perhaps there’s a way to isolate them and subtract them from the
   total count. For example, if 100 labels were uploaded via SDK and a user
   added 20 manual labels, the system currently counts 120 created labels. If
   we can flag or filter SDK-created labels, we could report only the 20
   manual ones for a more accurate breakdown. A similar approach could be
   extended to the review stages as well.
   -

   I’d also be very interested in learning more about how the Agent Stage
   could be utilized to support pre-labeling. Could we arrange a session to
   walk through how this would be implemented in our workflow?
   -

   Lastly, it would be greatly appreciated if we could receive the custom
   Excel export for the current dataset the team is working on. We’re looking
   forward to the estimated timeline for the vertex change tracking update by
   the end of this week.

looping in @James Forner <j.forner@abysssolutions.com.au> for visibility
who might help us get the dev work done if required. Looking forward to
meeting today.

Appreciate the collaboration!

Best,
Haider

Yearly Platform Fee Monthly Platform Fee Hourly price Number of hours per

subject: Artisight - labeling workstreams overview
text:
Hi Alex, Leo - here's the overview of the types of labeling workstreams Artisight is looking for rough pricing on at the per-frame level (cost per frame for classification, cost per frame for object detection), as well as a rough outline of the surgical labeling we're looking to expand.

• 
Production Model Improvement - 80% of labeling to start

• 

Patient Room - Fall Prevention - frame classification labeling - , 4 classes (no_patient, laying, sitting, standing) - ~20k frames per month

• 

Patient Room - Room State - object detection labeling - (medical equipment, patients, visitors, staff, chairs, beds) - ~20k frames per month

• 

OR - Room State - frame classification labeling - , 5 classes (room_empty, patient_transport, procedure_in_progress, room_setup, room_cleaning) - ~30k frames per month

• 
Surgical VLM - 10% of labeling to start

• 

Laparoscopic surgical videos (2-9 hours) labeled with key moments (e.g. trocar insertion, clipping, dissection, critical view of safety) and text descriptions of scenes for multimodal VLM training

• 

Laparoscopic surgical frames - general object detection labeling - anatomy, objects (graspers, trocar, etc...)

Happy to hop on a call this afternoon if you'd like!

Best,

Rob
